description: Demolition of existing building and erection of a new mixed use development up to six-storeys high, with a partial seventh-storey along Felsham Road frontage (recessed on all sides), plus the provision of basement levels, providing 3137 sq.m. of commercial floorspace (flexible class A1, A2 or A3 uses) at ground floor and basement level; 447 sq.m. of class D2 assembly and leisure use (predominantly at basement level with separate entrance off Walkers Place), and 97 residential units on the upper floors (comprising 1x studio, 33 x one-bedroom; 57 x two-bedroom and 6 x three-bedroom units), with associated balconies, roof terraces and winter gardens, with 26 basement car parking spaces (accessed via car lift off Felsham Road), and associated cycle parking spaces; mechanical plant; landscaping and public realm works, including provision of a new public square along Lacy Road.
